What we can build

Services

Whether you need a commercial campaign, an original cast for your narrative, or a world that doesn't exist yet — built to hold up at full resolution.

How a world takes shape

Process

Clear vision up front, custom ComfyUI pipelines under the hood, and careful optical finishing at the end.

01

Idea

Lock the story, references, lens mood, and exact deliverables.

02

Workflow

Build or tune a dedicated ComfyUI pipeline and train LoRAs if needed.

03

Variations

Explore angles, lighting setups, and compositions rapidly.

04

Selection

Pick the strongest frames and verify lettering, hands, and proportions.

05

Finish

Upscale, relight, color grade, and retouch in Photoshop for final delivery.

I'm Andrew Tymofeev, an AI visual artist based in Kyiv with a background in optics and three years building custom ComfyUI pipelines. Studying real light and lens behavior lets me turn imagination into crisp, believable imagery — whether it's a product launch, a character-driven story, or a fantasy world.
